Name: Gravel Sound Replacer
Author: DuckVendetta
Description:
Here is an updated version of my mod that replaces the gravel ("dirtyHit") sounds with grass ("grassyStep").

This mod is particularly useful if you enjoy using Seasonal Grass Path mods, but do not wish the for illusion to be spoiled by gravel sounds.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10232]Sound Effect Replacement[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to work.

Be sure to delete the previous version - [LAF] Gravel Sound Replacer.
